title: Profiling and optimization
goal: Choose a measurable operation and optimize without losing correctness or platform budgets.
prerequisites: onec.p9; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Actual input/output and exact own source identified; unperformed stages marked NOT RUN.
Accepted original preserved; rejection and its limits explained.
sections: Form-open time, server calls, memory and query time are different metrics. Define measurement boundaries, volume and environment. “Feels faster” is not acceptance. Use a small synthetic benchmark and explicitly distinguish it from field latency.
Repeat module 7 query measurement on an unchanged own set. Separate explicit 2 → 1 call count from observed durations. Verify keys/values first; losing a row is not acceptable optimization.

Collect baseline, then identify dominant operations. Optimizing a negligible function may not affect users. Count calls and repeated computations. Avoid changing algorithm, data and UI at once; sequential changes identify causes and permit rollback.

Open Designer → Debug → Performance measurement, run the own scenario and stop afterwards. If unavailable in the edition/version, record that and use admitted explicit counters without claiming internal SQL measurements.

Use equal data/versions, repeated runs and an agreed cache policy. Check values before speed. Removing permission or preservation checks is not optimization. One local timing is not p95, and small-data success does not prove million-row scaling.

Interpret metrics separately: calls, own section time and inclusive duration answer different questions. Retain at least five equal-condition raw runs, volume, version, order and cache assumptions. Exclude license/user information from screenshots.

Record budget, observed result and rejection conditions. Preserve regressions and return to the accepted version without deleting work. NEXUS-PERF-01 startup limits remain independent of teaching benchmarks. Test offline compression too: smaller files must preserve lesson access and progress.
Accept changes only with equivalent results and a predefined local budget. Keep the old version for rollback. This 1C investigation neither changes Nexus NEXUS-PERF-01 nor proves field p95.
